x: We all know that marathon runners are souls in torment but this is ridiculous. Only 25 miles 385 yds. to go Colin! A furtive moment caught by the camera; our road running Hon.
Over the next lap (less than two miles) Bautista and Colin "changed gear" and opened up a gap, we were now seeing world class walking. Carl hung on but one by one the three other Mexicans got away.

Easily the best of the remainder was Graham, whilst Carl was showing young Colin what its' all about (he slept through the proceedings). John was in good form and soon appeared and it was not long before Ray came in to give us another team win.

'Wait for a week', he said and sure enough 7 days later we heard that Barbara had produced a fine baby girl -Amy. In view of Barbara's athletics achievements and aware of son Colin's high energy quotient we suggest Carl raises the cot sides by 1 metre.
